liquidity_funding.text: The group repaid its interest-bearing financial liabilities in full, which the report says greatly reduces the sensitivity of the company to changes in interest rates.
Total debt was broadly unchanged at {{total_debt@FY2024}}, so gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} leaves little refinancing need and the funding base rests on internal cash generation.
A financing commitment was given to the City Air Terminal joint venture for new train sets, part of which was drawn as a loan in the year.
Shares acquired under a buyback programme in earlier years were still held by the company in the reporting year, and the programme had been terminated early.
